concepts.def: Technology vocabulary: der Computer, das Handy (mobile), das Tablet, das Internet, die sozialen Medien.
surfen (browse), herunterladen (download), hochladen (upload), chatten, eine E-Mail schicken.
After 'dass' (that), verb goes to end: 'Ich denke, dass das Internet wichtig ist.'
der Vorteil (advantage), der Nachteil (disadvantage). 'Der Vorteil ist, dass...' very common in essays.
'Ich kann mit Freunden chatten' (I can chat with friends). Main verb at end as infinitive.
Cyberbullying issue: das Cybermobbing, das Opfer (victim), der Täter (perpetrator), gefährlich (dangerous).

walkthroughs.body_html:
Theme 3: Communication and the World Around Us (Travel and Tourism; Media and Technology; The Environment and Where People Live) — a core area of GCSE German.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Theme 3: Communication and the World Around Us (Travel and Tourism; Media and Technology; The Environment and Where People Live) brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Theme 3: Communication and the World Around Us (Travel and Tourism; Media and Technology; The Environment and Where People Live).

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
